runs.name: 01-discovery-sign-on
runs.shows: Scripted stand-in for discovery: “Sign on to LegacyCore with the operator's service account” → legacycore.session.sign_on@1.0.0

runs.name: 02-discovery-savings-balance
runs.shows: Scripted stand-in for discovery: “Look up member 12345 and read their current share savings balance and the member's name” → legacycore.member.get_savings_balance@1.0.0

runs.name: 03-probe-member-not-found
runs.shows: Unknown screen after search → model classifies it → MEMBER_NOT_FOUND handler

runs.name: 05-probe-no-savings-share
runs.shows: Member without a savings share → NO_SAVINGS_ACCOUNT handler (guarded so it can never fire on the happy path)

runs.name: 10-replay-success
runs.shows: Deterministic replay, no model: outputs + verified checkpoint

runs.name: 11-replay-other-member
runs.shows: Same artifact, member whose share rows are re-ordered

runs.name: 14-replay-invalid-input
runs.shows: Caller error rejected before touching the UI

runs.name: 15-replay-recoveries
runs.shows: Interstitial, native dialog, HTTP 503 and session expiry — all recognised and recovered
recoveries: service_unavailable: reloaded main after 1000 ms backoff
maintenance_notice: clicked Acknowledge button on the system notice

runs.name: 16-replay-hard-failure
runs.shows: Unannounced vendor redesign → TARGET_NOT_FOUND with screenshot + DOM + expected/observed

runs.name: 17-replay-human-handoff
runs.shows: Unknown attestation screen → operator takes the live session via the console → hands back → run completes

runs.name: 20-tenant-bayview-no-override
runs.shows: Shared artifact on a variant tenant: drift reported; the read it can't do safely fails loudly instead of guessing (or claiming 'no savings')
recoveries: daily_security_notice: clicked Continue button on the security notice

runs.name: 21-tenant-bayview-with-override
recoveries: daily_security_notice: clicked Continue button on the security notice

runs.name: 22-tenant-bayview-no-savings
runs.shows: The override propagates into the probed handler: a Bayview member without savings gets the right business outcome
recoveries: daily_security_notice: clicked Continue button on the security notice
